failure_summary.description: Answers missed the requested exact granularity: they used an incidental plural, added an office or category noun, omitted a needed name suffix, or returned name parts already supplied by the clue.

patch.reasoning: The skill already directly covers each demonstrated issue: canonical number, implicit affiliations, partial names, disambiguating name parts, and omitting supplied category labels. These failures indicate noncompliance rather than a missing general rule, so another reminder would be redundant.
